messages:
Ivy Park: Quick idea 

Sushi + Sketch Social next Thursday? low-key: build-your-own sushi rolls + 15-min portrait sketch exchange. Bring one topping or a sketchbook if you have one. f363f58c
Ben Harper: hell yes. do you mean hand rolls? or full maki?
Ivy Park: either! well have rolling mats for maki and hand-roll station.
Noor Ali: can I bring nori and pickled ginger? also ill bring wasabi paste for the brave. 
Felix Zhou: I can bring sushi rice and a rice cooker if needed.
Carmen Ruiz: Ill bring vegan fillings (marinated tofu, avocado, cucumber). please label vegan stuff.
Jun Park: tiny question: anyone allergic to soy or sesame?
Theo Grant: peanut allergy here. Ill avoid anything with peanuts.
Ivy Park: noted, will ask folks to label. cap at 20 to keep it cozy.
Ben Harper: schedule idea: 6:00 prep, 6:30 rolling + eat, 7:15 quick sketch swap. 10-15 min portraits each. optional.
Ivy Park: that works. optional theme: "cartoon caricature" but totally optional.
Noor Ali: love the theme. can someone bring extra chopsticks and plates?
Felix Zhou: bringing disposable plates + a spare bowl for rice.
Carmen Ruiz: Ill bring some bamboo skewers and a little station sign for allergens.
OpsBot: Event created: "Sushi + Sketch Social" Thursday 18:00  Common Area. Reminder 1 hour before.
Jun Park: RSVP: react with :white_check_mark: = in, :x: = out, :question: = maybe.
Ben Harper: :white_check_mark:
Noor Ali: :white_check_mark:
Felix Zhou: :white_check_mark:
Carmen Ruiz: :white_check_mark:
Jun Park: :white_check_mark:
Theo Grant: :white_check_mark:
Ivy Park: RSVP count 7 so far. cap 20.
Ben Harper: tiny logistics: will we need gloves for food handling or is it potluck-style?
Ivy Park: good call. gloves and hand sanitizer on the table.
Noor Ali: can someone bring a small cutting board and a sharp knife? ill bring one but extra is handy.
Felix Zhou: bringing an extra knife and a small cutting board.
Carmen Ruiz: accessibility note: ill reserve a lower table for quieter sketchers.
Ivy Park: thanks! also will make a quick sign-up sheet for who brings what.
Theo Grant: prize idea: best sketch (people vote) gets a tiny sketch kit. low-stakes.
Noor Ali: love a prize.
Ben Harper: playlist rec: mellow indie + bossa nova for rolling rhythm.
Jun Park: rec: Norah Jones, Buena Vista Social Club mix.
Ivy Park: cool. ill add a playlist to the lounge board. final note: please label any foods with allergens and try to bring serving utensils. see you Thursday!
